questions: If you could redesign the moon, what quirky features would you add to it?
Imagine a library where the books come to life. What stories do you think the characters would tell?
Describe a day in the life of a talking teapot who loves to travel.

Invent a whimsical recipe for a dessert that changes flavor every bite.
Describe a dream where everyday objects come to life and have personalities.
You find a magic hat that lets you tell stories so vivid they come true. What story do you tell first?
Imagine a playground built in the clouds. What kinds of games are played there?
Describe a fantastical creature that only appears when you laugh really hard.
